reviews.comment: Engaging lectures. Very kind, intelligent, funny. She took over midway through the semester for our class and changed my entire outlook on the course. Our original professor made even the most basic equations look like Einstein's theory of relativity, but soon as she took over, concepts began making sense and were actually interesting. Love her.
I am feeling I took a high level math course. This course is boring and meaningless to graduate students. Please do not waste your time on her course

Professor Sukhishvili is very intelligent and can sometimes forget that we are new to the material. She can be hard to understand but with intent listening and reading along with the textbook I ended up okay in her class. She was helpful when I went to her office hours. She also assigns a presentation at the end of class purely for boosting grades.

reviews.comment: She cannot teach at all. Everything to her is easy math and she thinks quickly going through slides is sufficient to be a good prof. Quizzes every week. Homework is worth as much as an exam and Is due the class period before the exam so 2 exams in a week is fun. Any other class is a much better choice, I promise.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This course is absolute a waste of time. The professors slides are ridiculous, which always contain lots of nonsense and limited useful information. The course is more about formalism rather than imparting knowledge.

I dont suggest you to take this course. This professor is excellent, but the excellence occurs in research, not in teaching. Besides, this courses involves a lot of boring activities, which means you need to spend lots of time while get limited knowledge.

Dr. Sukhishvili is incredibly smart but has a hard time conveying that intelligence. If you haven't taken organic chem, then there is a bit of a learning curve however the class if quite math heavy/more physics based. She will definitely push your level of understanding and make you work for your grade.
